prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in West Palm Beach FL to sell my house?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent for every West Palm Beach home—the right choice depends on your neighborhood, price range, and property type. Based on the available directory results, **Jeff Tricoli’s team** is a reasonable first interview: Realtor.com lists 34 sales in the past year and 22 years’ experience, while other directories show a large volume of local transactions and many reviews. Those figures are team-level and directory rankings can use different methods, so treat them as a starting point, not a guarantee.

I’d interview **two or three agents**, including one who has recently sold homes very similar to yours nearby. Ask each for:
- Recent **seller-side** sales in your neighborhood and price range
- Their suggested list price, supported by comparable sales
- Typical time to sell and sale-to-list-price results
- Their marketing plan and who will handle showings and negotiations
- Commission, contract length, and cancellation terms

Compare their plans and local track records—not just their review count. If you share your neighborhood or ZIP code, approximate home value, and property type, I can help narrow down what to look for.
